Overview

Masaya is a city in MS with a population of 150,000. The cradle of Nicaraguan folklore, known for its artisan markets, active volcano, and indigenous traditions. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.0.
